svg.title: Figure 02 · Discrete loss distribution and tail risk
svg.desc: Losses 0, 10 and 100 have probabilities 94%, 4% and 2%. At 95% confidence, VaR is 10 and ES is 46. The plotted discrete quantile uses the inverse-CDF convention; hover returns sampled confidence levels.
